title: The Obstacle Yard
objective: Get past the yard's wall or its guard, see what lies beyond, and leave by the gate.

rooms.name: Yard Gate
rooms.description: A muddy yard inside an old gate. A crumbling wall hides a garden, and a guard leans on a door to the guardhouse.

features.name: Crumbling Wall
features.description: A wall of loose stone, a little over head height, with a garden beyond.

failure-by-5.text: The top stones give way and you land hard in the mud.

failure.text: You can't find a way over the loose stones.

success.text: You get over the wall and drop into the garden's shadow.

creatures.name: Gate Guard
creatures.description: A bored guard in a dented helmet, leaning on the guardhouse door.

topics.name: letting you pass
topics.reply: "Fine. Go on in, and don't touch anything." The guard steps aside.
topics.failure: "Not a chance." The guard folds his arms.

rooms.name: Herb Garden
rooms.description: Overgrown beds of herbs behind the wall.

features.name: Herb Bed
features.description: A raised bed of sage and thyme.
features.discovery: Someone has buried a small purse among the roots.

rooms.name: Guardhouse
rooms.description: A cramped guardhouse that smells of rats.

passages.description: The way over the crumbling wall.

endings.title: Out with the purse
endings.text: You leave by the gate with the garden's purse.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You leave by the gate with nothing.

endings.title: Fallen in the yard
endings.text: You fall in the yard's mud.
